definitions.explanation: The art of dancing, especially traditional or artistic dance forms.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧{舞踊|ぶよう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
{舞踊|ぶよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{公演|こうえん}→公演：11639_kouen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
⟦{舞踊家|ぶようか}→舞踊家：21769_buyouka⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{活躍|かつやく}している→活躍：02541_katsuyaku⟧。

notes:
{舞踊|ぶよう} is a formal, artistic term for dance, encompassing both Japanese traditional dance and Western dance forms.

ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{舞|ぶ}→舞：noentry⟧ (classical dance, twirling) + ⟦{踊|よう}→踊：noentry⟧ (lively dance, jumping). Together they cover the full range of dance as art.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧{舞踊|ぶよう}: Japanese traditional dance
- {舞踊|ぶよう}⟦{公演|こうえん}→公演：11639_kouen⟧: dance performance
- ⟦{舞踊家|ぶようか}→舞踊家：21769_buyouka⟧: dancer (professional)
- ⟦{創作|そうさく}→創作：04386_sousaku⟧{舞踊|ぶよう}: creative/contemporary dance

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ダンス→ダンス：03856_dansu⟧: dance (loanword, everyday, modern dance styles)
- ⟦{踊|おど}り→踊り：01347_odori⟧: dance (general, everyday)
- ⟦バレエ→バレエ：06504_baree⟧: ballet
- ⟦{舞|まい}→舞：noentry⟧: classical Japanese dance (more specific, traditional)
